Lakshmi Desai
Senior Go Developer | Noida, Uttar Pradesh
lakshmi.desai469@example.com | +91 9400400539

Experienced backend engineer focused on building resilient, high-throughput services in Go. Strong background in designing microservice architectures, operationalizing deployments on Kubernetes, and optimizing Postgres-backed workflows. Seeking roles that leverage system design and platform automation; current notice period is 90 days.

Experience

NimbusSoft — Jan 2022 - Aug 2026
Senior Go Developer — Remote
- Architected and implemented a suite of Go microservices handling transaction processing, reducing end-to-end latency by 38% while maintaining 99.95% availability; used Go and Kafka for reliable event-driven flows.
- Led migration of monolithic reporting pipelines to PostgreSQL-backed microservices and introduced schema partitioning and indexing strategies, improving query performance by 5x.
- Designed Kubernetes deployment patterns and CI/CD pipelines with automated rollbacks; cut deployment incident rate by 60% and enabled zero-downtime upgrades across clusters.
- Built Kafka consumer groups and producer clients in Go to process 200k+ events/sec during peak loads, with end-to-end monitoring and alerting tied into service-level indicators.

Saffron Bank — Oct 2021 - Dec 2021
Go Developer — On-site
- Implemented gRPC services in Go to replace legacy HTTP endpoints, improving internal API throughput and reducing payload overhead by 25%.
- Integrated Kafka-based event buses for transaction notifications and reconciliation, enabling near real-time downstream processing and reducing batch windows from hours to minutes.
- Added structured logging and tracing to gRPC handlers to reduce mean-time-to-detection for payment issues by 40%.

GreenGrid — Nov 2019 - Sep 2021
Platform Engineer — Hybrid
- Developed platform tooling in Go to provision and manage Kubernetes namespaces and Postgres instances, accelerating developer on-boarding by 3x.
- Enhanced PostgreSQL reliability with automated backups, PITR procedures and connection pool tuning, reducing incident recovery time from hours to under 30 minutes.
- Containerized platform components using Docker and created Helm charts for repeatable deployments, standardizing environments across staging and production.
- Automated Git-based CI workflows and integrated Kafka health checks into platform dashboards to improve operational visibility.

Projects
- Real-time Metrics Aggregator: Built a Go service that consumed Kafka topics, aggregated metrics and wrote to Postgres with efficient batch commits; supported 50k metrics/sec ingestion in tests.
- DevTools CLI: Created a Docker-enabled CLI in Go to scaffold microservices, generate gRPC stubs and automate local K8s cluster setups for developer productivity.

Languages: Go
RPC & Messaging: gRPC, Kafka
Orchestration & Containerization: K8s, Docker
Datastore & Patterns: PostgreSQL, Microservices
